entries.name: Bandits.condDistrib_reward''
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_1 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] [Countable 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (n : ℕ), ⇑𝓛[fun ω => R n ω.1 | fun ω => A n ω.1; P.prod (Bandits.streamMeasure ν)] =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => A n ω.1) (P.prod (Bandits.streamMeasure ν))] ⇑ν

entries.name: Bandits.condDistrib_rewardByCount_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] [StandardBorelSpace 𝓐] [Nonempty 𝓐] [StandardBorelSpace Ω] [Countable 𝓐], Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → ∀ (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ), m ≠ 0 → ⇑𝓛[Learning.rewardByCount A R a m | fun ω => Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1; P.prod (Bandits.streamMeasure ν)] =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun ω => Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1) (P.prod (Bandits.streamMeasure ν))] ⇑(ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const ℕ∞ (ν a))

entries.name: Bandits.condIndepFun_reward_stepsUntil_action
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel 𝓐 ℝ} [inst_2 : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] [StandardBorelSpace 𝓐] [Nonempty 𝓐] [inst_5 : StandardBorelSpace Ω] [inst_6 : Countable 𝓐] (h : Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R alg (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P) (a : 𝓐) (m n : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun (MeasurableSpace.comap (fun ω => A n ω.1) m𝓐) ⋯ (fun ω => R n ω.1) ({ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ↑n}.indicator fun x => 1) (P.prod (Bandits.streamMeasure ν))

entries.name: Bandits.condIndepFun_reward_stepsUntil_action'

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ), M.IsSymm → ∀ (t : ℝ) (state : WithLp 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), Lasso.dlnVectorField M r lambda t state = (WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).symm (-(Lasso.hadamard ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).2 (Lasso.matVec M (Lasso.hadamard ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).1 ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).2) - r) + lambda • ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).1), -(Lasso.hadamard ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).1 (Lasso.matVec M (Lasso.hadamard ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).1 ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).2) - r) + lambda • ((WithLp.equiv 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) state).2))

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda ε : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β u → (∀ (t : ℝ) (i : ι), (Lasso.posEffectiveParameter u t).ofLp i ≠ 0) → M.IsSymm → ∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun t => (WithLp.equiv 2 (ι → ℝ)).symm fun i => 1 / 4 * Real.log ((Lasso.posEffectiveParameter u t).ofLp i)) ((WithLp.equiv 2 (ι → ℝ)).symm fun i => -(M.mulVec (Lasso.posEffectiveParameter u t).ofLp i - r.ofLp i + lambda)) t

entries.name: Lasso.energy_complementarity_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∃ C > 0, Lasso.pseudoInverseSeminorm Mdagger r ≤ C ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s → deriv (fun σ => 1 / (1 + σ * lambda) * (inner ℝ (w σ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) σ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso σ) + Lasso.pathDelta M (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) σ)) τ - inner ℝ (deriv (fun σ => (1 / (1 + σ * lambda)) • w σ) τ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) τ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso τ) ≤ C * (1 / Real.log (1 / ε) * (1 + deriv (Lasso.positiveZUpward x_lasso) τ) + deriv (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso) τ) + δ

entries.name: Lasso.energy_complementarity_bound_of_monotone
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M Mdagger : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ (w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ParametricLCPDualRegular M Mdagger r lambda w → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso μ) (w μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → (∀ (ν ν' : ℝ), 0 ≤ ν → ν ≤ ν' → ∀ (i : ι), ν * (x_lasso ν).ofLp i ≤ ν' * (x_lasso ν').ofLp i) → ∃ C > 0, Lasso.pseudoInverseSeminorm Mdagger r ≤ C ∧ ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s → deriv (fun σ => 1 / (1 + σ * lambda) * (inner ℝ (w σ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) σ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso σ) + Lasso.pathDelta M (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) σ)) τ - inner ℝ (deriv (fun σ => (1 / (1 + σ * lambda)) • w σ) τ) (Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) τ - Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso τ) ≤ C * (1 / Real.log (1 / ε) * (1 + deriv (Lasso.positiveZUpward x_lasso) τ) + deriv (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso) τ) + δ

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ), Lasso.IsPositiveSemidefinite M → ∀ (r y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.matVec M y = r → ∀ (lambda : ℝ), 0 ≤ lambda → ∀ (z w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (z μ) (w μ)) → ∀ (μ h : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → 0 < h → ∃ ξ, h⁻¹ • (Lasso.scaledDualPath lambda w (μ + h) - Lasso.scaledDualPath lambda w μ) = Lasso.matVec M ξ ∧ inner ℝ ξ (Lasso.matVec M ξ) ≤ inner ℝ y (Lasso.matVec M y)

entries.name: Lasso.lasso_connection_approx
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β γ : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (w : ℝ → ℝ → WithLp 2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → (∀ (i : ι), β.ofLp i ≠ γ.ofLp i ∧ β.ofLp i ≠ -γ.ofLp i) → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.dlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β γ (w ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnPositiveCompacts x_lasso → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath fun μ => Lasso.signedCanonicalSplit (x_lasso μ)) → (Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable fun μ => Lasso.signedCanonicalSplit (x_lasso μ)) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ s > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), Lasso.lassoObjective M r lambda s (Lasso.averageTrajectory (w ε) (Lasso.timeFromRescaled ε s)) ≤ Lasso.lassoMin M r lambda s + C * Lasso.suboptimalityGap lambda s (Lasso.signedZDownward x_lasso s) + δ

entries.name: Lasso.pos_delta_bound_1
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, inner ℝ (deriv (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) τ) (Lasso.posRescaledMirrorVariable ε (u ε) τ) ≤ C / Real.log (1 / ε)

entries.name: Lasso.pos_delta_bound_2
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, -inner ℝ (deriv (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) τ) (Lasso.matVec M (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso τ) - τ • r + (1 + τ * lambda) • Lasso.ones) ≤ 0

entries.name: Lasso.pos_delta_bound_3
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → (∀ (τ' : ℝ) (i' : ι), 0 ≤ τ' → DifferentiableAt ℝ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ' → ∃ ε > 0, ∀ (t : ℝ), |t - τ'| < ε → deriv (fun u' => u' * (x_lasso u').ofLp i') t = deriv (fun u' => u' * (x_lasso u').ofLp i') τ') → ∃ C > 0, ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, -inner ℝ (deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ) (Lasso.posRescaledMirrorVariable ε (u ε) τ) ≤ C * (1 / Real.log (1 / ε) * deriv (Lasso.positiveZUpward x_lasso) τ + deriv (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso) τ)

entries.name: Lasso.pos_delta_bound_3_of_monotone
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → (∀ (ν ν' : ℝ), 0 ≤ ν → ν ≤ ν' → ∀ (i : ι), ν * (x_lasso ν).ofLp i ≤ ν' * (x_lasso ν').ofLp i) → ∃ C > 0, ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, -inner ℝ (deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ) (Lasso.posRescaledMirrorVariable ε (u ε) τ) ≤ C * (1 / Real.log (1 / ε) * deriv (Lasso.positiveZUpward x_lasso) τ + deriv (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso) τ)

entries.name: Lasso.pos_delta_bound_4
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, inner ℝ (deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ) (Lasso.matVec M (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso τ) - τ • r + (1 + τ * lambda) • Lasso.ones) + inner ℝ (deriv (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) τ - deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ) (Lasso.ones - Lasso.posRescaledMirrorVariable ε (u ε) 0) ≤ δ

entries.name: Lasso.pos_delta_bound_4_term2
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∃ C > 0, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, ‖deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ‖ ≤ C) → ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, inner ℝ (deriv (fun ρ => Lasso.posIntegratedTrajectoryRescaled ε (u ε) ρ) τ - deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ) (Lasso.ones - Lasso.posRescaledMirrorVariable ε (u ε) 0) ≤ δ

entries.name: Lasso.pos_lasso_connection_approx
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnPositiveCompacts x_lasso → Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∃ C > 0, ∀ s > 0, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ᶠ (ε : ℝ) in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (Lasso.posAverageTrajectory (u ε) (Lasso.posTimeFromRescaled ε s)) ≤ Lasso.posLassoMin M r lambda s + C * Lasso.suboptimalityGap lambda s (Lasso.positiveZDownward x_lasso s) + δ

entries.name: Lasso.pos_lasso_connection_monotone
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (β : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (u : ℝ → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → Lasso.NonzeroCoordinates β → (∀ ε > 0, Lasso.posDlnGradientFlow M r lambda ε β (u ε)) → ∀ (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → (∀ (i : ι), MonotoneOn (fun μ => μ * (x_lasso μ).ofLp i) (Set.Ioi 0)) → Filter.Tendsto (fun ε => Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (Lasso.posAverageTrajectory (u ε) (Lasso.posTimeFromRescaled ε s))) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (Lasso.posLassoMin M r lambda s))

entries.name: Lasso.positiveLassoObjective_eq_energy
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∀ (z zε w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.Nonnegative (s⁻¹ • z) → Lasso.Nonnegative (s⁻¹ • zε) → Lasso.matVec M (s⁻¹ • z) + Lasso.lcpQ r lambda s = s⁻¹ • w → M.IsSymm → Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (s⁻¹ • zε) - Lasso.positiveLassoObjective M r lambda s (s⁻¹ • z) = s⁻¹ ^ 2 * (inner ℝ w (zε - z) + 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (zε - z) (Lasso.matVec M (zε - z)))

entries.name: Lasso.quadratic_expansion
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (q x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), M.IsSymm → 1 / 2 * inner ℝ y (Lasso.matVec M y) + inner ℝ q y - (1 / 2 * inner ℝ x (Lasso.matVec M x) + inner ℝ q x) = 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (y - x) (Lasso.matVec M (y - x)) + inner ℝ (Lasso.matVec M x + q) (y - x)

entries.name: Lasso.quadratic_expansion_eval
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (q x d : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (t : ℝ), M.IsSymm → 1 / 2 * inner ℝ (x + t • d) (Lasso.matVec M (x + t • d)) + inner ℝ q (x + t • d) - (1 / 2 * inner ℝ x (Lasso.matVec M x) + inner ℝ q x) = t ^ 2 * (1 / 2 * inner ℝ d (Lasso.matVec M d)) + t * inner ℝ (Lasso.matVec M x + q) d

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_ae_differentiable
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s → DifferentiableAt ℝ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_coord_affine_at_differentiable
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∀ (i : ι) (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun u' => u' * (x_lasso u').ofLp i) μ → ∃ a b, ∀ᶠ (t : ℝ) in nhds μ, t * (x_lasso t).ofLp i = a * t + b

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_deriv_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.LocallyLipschitzOnCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) → ∀ (s : ℝ), 0 < s → ∃ C > 0, ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 s, ‖deriv (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ‖ ≤ C

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_deriv_locally_constant
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ScaledPrimalPathLocallyAffineAtDifferentiable x_lasso → ∀ (τ' : ℝ) (i' : ι), 0 ≤ τ' → DifferentiableAt ℝ (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso) τ' → ∃ ε > 0, ∀ (t : ℝ), |t - τ'| < ε → deriv (fun u' => (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso u').ofLp i') t = deriv (fun u' => (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso u').ofLp i') τ'

entries.name: Lasso.scaledPrimalPath_regular_of_path_regular
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (x_lasso : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsPositiveLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x_lasso μ)) → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnPositiveCompacts x_lasso → Lasso.LocallyAbsolutelyContinuousOnNonnegativeCompacts (Lasso.scaledPrimalPath x_lasso)

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_diff_quot_eq_matVec
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.matVec M y = r → ∀ (wt zt : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ (ν : ℝ), 0 ≤ ν → wt ν = -s ν • r + Lasso.ones + Lasso.matVec M (zt ν)) → ∀ (μ h : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → 0 < h → h⁻¹ • (wt (μ + h) - wt μ) = Lasso.matVec M (-((s (μ + h) - s μ) / h) • y + h⁻¹ • (zt (μ + h) - zt μ))

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_dual_lcp_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (z w : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), 0 ≤ lambda → (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → Lasso.isParametricLCP M r lambda μ (z μ) (w μ)) → ∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → have wt := Lasso.scaledDualPath lambda w μ; have zt := (1 / (1 + μ * lambda)) • z μ; have s := μ / (1 + μ * lambda); wt = -s • r + Lasso.ones + Lasso.matVec M zt ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative wt ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative zt ∧ inner ℝ wt zt = 0

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_dual_lcp_key_ineq
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.IsPositiveSemidefinite M → ∀ (wt zt : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (s : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ (μ : ℝ), 0 ≤ μ → wt μ = -s μ • r + Lasso.ones + Lasso.matVec M (zt μ) ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative (wt μ) ∧ Lasso.Nonnegative (zt μ) ∧ inner ℝ (wt μ) (zt μ) = 0) → ∀ {μ₁ μ₂ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ μ₁ → 0 ≤ μ₂ → inner ℝ (zt μ₁ - zt μ₂) (Lasso.matVec M (zt μ₁ - zt μ₂)) ≤ |s μ₁ - s μ₂| * |inner ℝ r (zt μ₁ - zt μ₂)|

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_dual_lcp_s_diff_bound
entries.statement: ∀ (lambda : ℝ), 0 ≤ lambda → ∀ {μ ν : ℝ}, 0 ≤ μ → 0 ≤ ν → have s := fun μ => μ / (1 + μ * lambda); |s μ - s ν| ≤ |μ - ν|

entries.name: Lasso.scaled_dual_lipschitz

entries.name: Lasso.signedCanonicalSplit_scaled_monotonicity
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (lambda : ℝ) (x : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι), Lasso.ProblemData M r lambda → (∀ μ > 0, Lasso.IsLassoMinimizer M r lambda μ (x μ)) → (∀ (i : ι), MonotoneOn (fun μ => μ * (x μ).ofLp i) (Set.Ioi 0) ∨ AntitoneOn (fun μ => μ * (x μ).ofLp i) (Set.Ioi 0)) → ∀ (j : ι ⊕ ι), MonotoneOn (fun μ => μ * (Lasso.signedCanonicalSplit (x μ)).ofLp j) (Set.Ioi 0)

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) t ω + 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω + if A t ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_add_one_eq_pullCount'

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω'

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n → Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, n ≠ 0 → Learning.pullCount A a n ω = Learning.pullCount' (n - 1) (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_pullCount_of_action_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, A t ω ≠ a → Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_eq_sum
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω = ∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, if A s ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≤ t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_le_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (n C : ℕ) (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ C + 1 + ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, {s | A s ω = a ∧ C < Learning.pullCount A a s ω}.indicator 1 s

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_forall_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {n t : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∀ (s : ℕ), Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω ≠ t) → t ≠ 0 → Learning.pullCount A a n ω < t

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_lt_of_le_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ} (ω : Ω), (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → ↑n < Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω → Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_mono
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) {n m : ℕ}, n ≤ m → ∀ (ω : Ω), Learning.pullCount A a n ω ≤ Learning.pullCount A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a 1 ω = if A 0 ω = a then 1 else 0

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.pullCount A a (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω).toNat ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_stepsUntil_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.pullCount A a (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω + 1).toNat ω = m

entries.name: Learning.pullCount_zero_apply

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure 𝓐) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (x : ℕ), (Learning.randomSampling μ).policy x = ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.const (↥(Finset.Iic x) → 𝓐 × 𝓨) μ

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → {Ω : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → (ℕ → Ω → R) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R) → R

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_add
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [inst_1 : AddMonoid R] (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m = ({ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤}.indicator fun ω => R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1) + {ω | Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤}.indicator fun ω => ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_ite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = if Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ then ω.2 m a else R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_eq_stoppedValue
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = MeasureTheory.stoppedValue R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m) ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_coe
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ↑n → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' n ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_eq_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 = ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = ω.2 m a

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_of_stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1 ≠ ⊤ → Learning.rewardByCount A R' a m ω = R' (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω.1).toNat ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_pullCount_add_one_eq_reward
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (t : ℕ) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' (A t ω.1) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω.1) t ω.1 + 1) ω = R' t ω.1

entries.name: Learning.rewardByCount_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω × (ℕ → 𝓐 → R)), Learning.rewardByCount A R' a 0 ω = if A 0 ω.1 = a then ω.2 0 a else R' 0 ω.1

entries.name: Learning.roundRobinAlgorithm

entries.name: Learning.snd_eval_comp_history
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {Y : ℕ → Ω → 𝓨} (n : ℕ), (fun x => (x ⟨n, ⋯⟩).2) ∘ Learning.history A Y n = Y n

entries.name: Learning.stationaryEnv

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → {𝓨 : Type u_2} → {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} → {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} → Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨 → Learning.Environment 𝓐 𝓨 → (n : ℕ) → ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (↥(Finset.Iic n) → 𝓐 × 𝓨) (𝓐 × 𝓨)

entries.name: Learning.stepKernel_def
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {𝓨 : Type u_2} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨} (alg : Learning.Algorithm 𝓐 𝓨) (env : Learning.Environment 𝓐 𝓨) (n : ℕ), Learning.stepKernel alg env n = (alg.policy n).compProd (env.feedback n)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → {Ω : Type u_3} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (ℕ → Ω → 𝓐) → 𝓐 → ℕ → Ω → ℕ∞

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_congr
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m n : ℕ} {ω ω' : Ω}, (∀ i ≤ n, A i ω = A i ω') → (Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω' = ↑n)

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_dite
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (m : ℕ) (ω : Ω) [inst_1 : Decidable (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m)], Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = if h : ∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m then ↑(Nat.find h) else ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω} (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω = m ∧ ∀ k < n, Learning.pullCount A a (k + 1) ω < m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_iff'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, m ≠ 0 → ∀ (n : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = ↑n ↔ A n ω = a ∧ Learning.pullCount A a n ω = m - 1

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_leastGE
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {m : ℕ} (a : 𝓐), m ≠ 0 → Learning.stepsUntil A a m = MeasureTheory.leastGE (fun n ω => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1) ω) m

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_top_iff

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_eq_zero_iff
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω = 0 ↔ m = 0 ∧ A 0 ω ≠ a ∨ m = 1 ∧ A 0 ω = a

entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (a : 𝓐) (ω : Ω) {n m : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n ≤ m → Learning.stepsUntil A a n ω ≤ Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_ne_top
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {m : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, (∃ s, Learning.pullCount A a (s + 1) ω = m) → Learning.stepsUntil A a m ω ≠ ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_one_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 1 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A (A t ω) (Learning.pullCount A (A t ω) (t + 1) ω) ω = ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_pullCount_le
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} (ω : Ω) (a : 𝓐) (t : ℕ), Learning.stepsUntil A a (Learning.pullCount A a (t + 1) ω) ω ≤ ↑t

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω = a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = ⊤

entries.name: Learning.stepsUntil_zero_of_ne
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω}, A 0 ω ≠ a → Learning.stepsUntil A a 0 ω = 0

entries.name: Learning.stronglyAdapted_pullCount_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} {Ω : Type u_3} {m𝓐 : MeasurableSpace 𝓐} {mR : MeasurableSpace R} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → R} [MeasurableSingletonClass 𝓐] (hA : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (A n)) (hR' : ∀ (n : ℕ), Measurable (R' n)) (a : 𝓐), MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted (Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq.filtration hA hR') fun n => Learning.pullCount A a (n + 1)

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards'
entries.statement: {𝓐 : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq 𝓐] → (n : ℕ) → (↥(Finset.Iic n) → 𝓐 × ℝ) → 𝓐 → ℝ

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {ω : Ω} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}, Learning.sumRewards A R' a (t + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards A R' a t ω + if A t ω = a then R' t ω else 0

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_add_one_eq_sumRewards'
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {n : ℕ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.sumRewards A R' a (n + 1) ω = Learning.sumRewards' n (fun i => (A (↑i) ω, R' (↑i) ω)) a

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_of_pullCount_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {ω : Ω} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {s t : ℕ}, Learning.pullCount A a s ω = Learning.pullCount A a t ω → Learning.sumRewards A R' a s ω = Learning.sumRewards A R' a t ω

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_pullCount_mul_empMean
entries.statement: ∀ {𝓐 : Type u_1} {Ω : Type u_3} [inst : DecidableEq 𝓐] {A : ℕ → Ω → 𝓐} {a : 𝓐} {t : ℕ} {R' : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {ω : Ω}, Learning.pullCount A a t ω ≠ 0 → Learning.sumRewards A R' a t ω = ↑(Learning.pullCount A a t ω) * Learning.empMean A R' a t ω

entries.name: Learning.sumRewards_eq_sumRewards'

entries.statement: ∀ {K : ℕ} {hK : 0 < K} {c : ℝ} {ν : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel (Fin K) ℝ} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel ν] {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {A : ℕ → Ω → Fin K} {R : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {σ2 : NNReal}, Learning.IsAlgEnvSeq A R (Bandits.ucbAlgorithm hK (c * ↑σ2)) (Learning.stationaryEnv ν) P → (∀ (a : Fin K), ProbabilityTheory.HasSubgaussianMGF (fun x => x - ∫ (x : ℝ), id x ∂ν a) σ2 (ν a)) → σ2 ≠ 0 → 0 < c → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∫ (x : Ω), Bandits.regret ν A n x ∂P ≤ ∑ a, (8 * c * ↑σ2 * Real.log (↑n + 1) / Bandits.gap ν a + Bandits.gap ν a * (2 + 2 * (Bandits.UCB.constSum c n).toReal))

entries.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.compProd_eq_compProd_withDensity_comp_snd
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ] {κ η : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel κ] [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel η] {f : β → ENNReal}, Measurable f → ⇑κ =ᵐ[μ] ⇑(η.withDensity fun x b => f b) → μ.compProd κ = (μ.compProd η).withDensity fun ab => f ab.2

entries.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.compProd_withDensity_left
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel κ] {f : α → ENNReal}, Measurable f → (μ.withDensity f).compProd κ = (μ.compProd κ).withDensity fun ab => f ab.1

entries.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.compProd_withDensity_withDensity
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ] {κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α β} [inst : ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel κ] {f : α → ENNReal} {g : α → β → ENNReal}, Measurable f → Measurable (Function.uncurry g) → ∀ [ProbabilityTheory.IsSFiniteKernel (κ.withDensity g)], (μ.withDensity f).compProd (κ.withDensity g) = (μ.compProd κ).withDensity fun ac => f ac.1 * g ac.1 ac.2

entries.name: MeasureTheory.Measure.sub_apply_eq_rnDeriv_add_singularPart
entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ν] (s : Set α), (μ - ν) s = (ν.withDensity fun a => μ.rnDeriv ν a - 1) s + (μ.singularPart ν) s

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} [inst : Fintype ι] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (k : ℕ) (x : ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) (o : κ) (c d : ℤ), L.preactivation k x o c d = L.bias o + ∑ i, ∑ dc ∈ NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.window k, ∑ dd ∈ NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.window k, L.weight o i dc dd * x i (c + dc) (d + dd)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_eq_toLocalDenseLayer

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_ofOffsetTiedDense

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.preactivation_shift
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} [inst : Fintype ι] (L : NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer ι κ) (k : ℕ) (x : ι → ℤ → ℤ → ℝ) (a b : ℤ), L.preactivation k (NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.shift a b x) = NeuralNetwork.Conv2DLayer.shift a b (L.preactivation k x)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude_append
entries.statement: ∀ (Cw : NNReal) (q : ℝ) (m n : ℕ) (widths : List ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw q m (widths ++ [n]) = ↑Cw ^ m * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m n * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw q m widths

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.covariance_batchOutputLaw
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (D : A → Fin dIn → ℝ) (a b : A) (i j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun z => z a i) (fun z => z b j) (S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D) = if i = j then ↑Cw ^ S.depth * NeuralNetwork.normalizedGram D a b else 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.covariance_batchOutputLaw_closedForm
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (D : A → Fin dIn → ℝ) (a b : A) (i j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : A → Fin dOut → ℝ), z a i * z b j ∂S.deepLinearBatchLaw Cw D = if i = j then ↑Cw ^ S.depth * NeuralNetwork.normalizedGram D a b else 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.covariance_sq_coordinates
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (j k : Fin dOut), j ≠ k → 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun z => z j ^ 2) (fun z => z k ^ 2) (S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) = (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 S.hiddenWidths - 1) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) S.hiddenWidths ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.fourPointAmplitude_eq

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_coordinate_pow_outputLaw_even
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (j : Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : Fin dOut → ℝ), z j ^ (2 * m) ∂S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.gaussianEvenCoeff m * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) m S.hiddenWidths

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_normalizedEnergy_pow_randomLayerKernel
entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type uI} {κ : Type uJ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (Cw : NNReal) (x : ι → ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < Fintype.card κ → ∫ (z : κ → ℝ), NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy z ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.oneLayerOutputLaw Cw x = (↑Cw * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) ^ m * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m (Fintype.card κ)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.integral_normalizedEnergy_pow_stdGaussian
entries.statement: ∀ (m n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∫ (g : Fin n → ℝ), NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy g ^ m ∂NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.standardGaussianVectorLaw n = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor m n

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.jointCumulant_four_outputLaw
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (a : Fin 4 → Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → (Renormalization.jointCumulant (S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) fun r z => z (a r)) = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.pairingTensor a * (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 S.hiddenWidths - 1) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) S.hiddenWidths ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.jointMoment_outputLaw_even
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * m) → Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : Fin dOut → ℝ), ∏ r, z (a r) ∂S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.pairingTensor a * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) m S.hiddenWidths

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.jointMoment_outputLaw_odd
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (a : Fin (2 * m + 1) → Fin dOut), 0 < dIn → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ∫ (z : Fin dOut → ℝ), ∏ r, z (a r) ∂S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x = 0

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.map_batchPreactivation
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type uA} {ι : Type uI} {κ : Type uJ} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : DecidableEq A] (Cw : NNReal) (x : A → ι → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun q j => NeuralNetwork.batchToEuclidean (NeuralNetwork.batchPreactivation q x) j) (NeuralNetwork.layerGaussianInit (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hyperparams Cw) ι κ) = MeasureTheory.Measure.pi fun x_1 => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 fun a b => ↑Cw * NeuralNetwork.normalizedGram x a b

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.sixPointAmplitude_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (Cw : NNReal) (q : ℝ) (widths : List ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw q 3 widths = NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 3 widths * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 3

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.sixthCumulantAmplitude_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (Cw : NNReal) (q : ℝ) (widths : List ℕ), NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.correlatorAmplitude Cw q 3 widths - 3 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 widths * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 3 + 2 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 3 = (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 3 widths - 3 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 widths + 2) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw q widths ^ 3

entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin n → ℝ)

entries.statement: ∀ (Cw q : ℝ), 1 < Cw → q ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun L => |Cw ^ L * q|) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_correlatorAmplitude_fixedWidth_atTop
entries.statement: ∀ (m width : ℕ) (q : ℝ), 2 ≤ m → 0 < width → 0 < q → Filter.Tendsto (fun depth => NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection m width depth * q ^ m) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

entries.statement: ∀ (Cw q : ℝ), 1 < Cw → 0 < q → Filter.Tendsto (fun L => Cw ^ L * q) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop

entries.statement: ∀ (Cw q : ℝ), 0 ≤ Cw → Cw < 1 → Filter.Tendsto (fun L => Cw ^ L * q) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_equalWidthCorrection_doubleScaling
entries.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (L : ℕ → ℕ) (r : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(L n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection m n (L n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp (↑m * ↑(m - 1) * r)))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_equalWidth_correlatorAmplitude
entries.statement: ∀ (m depth : ℕ) (G2 : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun width => NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection m width depth * G2 ^ m) Filter.atTop (nhds (G2 ^ m))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_fourthCumulantAmplitude_doubleScaling
entries.statement: ∀ (L : ℕ → ℕ) (r q : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(L n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection 2 n (L n) - 1) * q ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds ((Real.exp (2 * r) - 1) * q ^ 2))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_outputLaw_fixedDepth_atTop
entries.statement: ∀ (dIn dOut hiddenDepth : ℕ) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ), 0 < dIn → Filter.Tendsto (fun width => (NeuralNetwork.MLPShape.constantHiddenShape dIn dOut width hiddenDepth).deepLinearOutputProbabilityMeasure Cw x) Filter.atTop (nhds (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.iidGaussianProbabilityMeasure dOut (Cw ^ (hiddenDepth + 1) * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergyNNReal x)))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.tendsto_sixthCumulantAmplitude_doubleScaling
entries.statement: ∀ (L : ℕ → ℕ) (r q : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto L Filter.atTop Filter.atTop → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(L n) / ↑n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection 3 n (L n) - 3 * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.equalWidthCorrection 2 n (L n) + 2) * q ^ 3) Filter.atTop (nhds ((Real.exp (6 * r) - 3 * Real.exp (2 * r) + 2) * q ^ 3))

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude
entries.statement: NNReal → ℝ → List ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.variance_normalizedEnergy
entries.statement: ∀ {dIn dOut : ℕ} (S : NeuralNetwork.MLPShape dIn dOut) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ), 0 < dIn → 0 < dOut → (∀ n ∈ S.hiddenWidths, 0 < n) → ProbabilityTheory.variance NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy (S.deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) = (NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.hiddenWidthCorrection 2 S.hiddenWidths * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor 2 dOut - 1) * NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.twoPointAmplitude Cw (NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) S.hiddenWidths ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.variance_normalizedEnergy_equalWidth
entries.statement: ∀ (dIn width hiddenDepth : ℕ) (Cw : NNReal) (x : Fin dIn → ℝ), 0 < dIn → 0 < width → ProbabilityTheory.variance NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy ((NeuralNetwork.MLPShape.constantHiddenShape dIn width width hiddenDepth).deepLinearOutputLaw Cw x) = ((1 + 2 / ↑width) ^ (hiddenDepth + 1) - 1) * (↑Cw ^ (hiddenDepth + 1) * NeuralNetwork.normalizedEnergy x) ^ 2

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor_three

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.widthMomentFactor_two

entries.name: NeuralNetwork.DeepLinear.width_depth_limits_do_not_commute
